cases.description: Canonical sorted ASCII/LF encoding and bounded depth; parity with reference recipe
Reject duplicate/unknown keys, NaN/float/bool-as-int and scalar overflow
Reject OFFLINE_MODEL and future SCM schema/domain on every live wire message
Reject arbitrary scenario, command, argv, nonzero SCM budget or Guard descriptor
Bind READY to request/runtime/capsule/layout/policy/schema pins
Bind authorization to exact ready key and host session-binding record
Reject malformed/truncated completion markers; bounded PENDING only for absence/sharing
Reconstruct acyclic hashes without embedding own manifest/request hash in ancestors
Only four mappings: Input Runtime Control RO and Output RW; full fixed XML assertions
Reject overlaps with repo .git .venv credentials accepted-store and whole Downloads
Reject UNC ADS device names traversal short aliases duplicate case and reparse metadata
Capsule contains only fixed guest/runtime shared modules; no tests/SCM/Guard entrypoints
Guest runtime retains exact 37-file inventory; no host .venv fallback
Bootstrap copy mismatch stops before interpreter; no install or ACL repair
Runtime _pth/import path isolation; no accidental CWD or environment injection
Unsupported mandatory WSB settings cause refusal without silent downgrade
No grant or malformed grant: zero launch attempts
Operator grant not manufactured by guest files/model receipt/JSON approved flag
Concurrent reservation: exactly one CREATE_NEW winner; other stops
Partial consumed record and unknown flush poison grant; no rewrite
Launch attempt recorded before native call; failed call does not refund budget
Authorization intent/attempt recorded once; data-only partial publication does not retry
Unknown commit publication remains UNKNOWN even if worker later exits
Restart with unresolved launch blocks new run; no auto deletion/adoption
Strict normal phase order including anchor before ready pin and auth before terminal
Failure terminal immediately sticky; later normal retirement never clears failure
Late valid retirement records completion while retaining timeout failure (R107-02)
Launcher exit alone not retirement; live persistent anchor blocks acceptance
Forced cleanup permanently forbids successful receipt
Wrong run/nonce/boot/anchor observation invalidates binding
Monotonic host deadlines cannot be extended by guest ticks or late heartbeat
Failure/unknown/terminal states forbid relaunch and second authorization
Successful benign digest roundtrip expected result calculated on host
READY signature proof-of-possession does not become SYSTEM/source-origin assertion
Key replacement after pin rejected, including another valid key
Cross-domain valid-looking signature never accepted; domain prehash explicit
Journal sequence, exact result and termination shape checked; no SCM events
Extra files, excessive size, failure.json or changed signature/hash reject success
Post-exit stable exact snapshot and native receipts required before accepted-store
Fake crypto/retirement receipts cannot create live successful verdict
Process32First false + ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES distinguished from other errors
Mid-enumeration Process32Next failure never reports empty/complete
GetProcessTimes/image/token metadata unavailable produces UNKNOWN not absence
PID reused or path/creation mismatch refuses cleanup/identity adoption
TerminateProcess success plus Wait timeout remains unconfirmed cleanup
CNG prehash exactly once, 72-byte public blob and 64-byte signature, NTSTATUS failures closed
File same-handle bounded read rechecks FileID/volume/link/size and all path components
CREATE_NEW short write, flush failure, sharing violation and handle-close cleanup covered
Exactly one supervisor-bound artifact worker; worker has no Sandbox launch function
Suspended worker assigned to own job before resume; no Sandbox service in Job
DETACHED_PROCESS instead of CREATE_NO_WINDOW; unexpected extra PID is failure not exemption
Hung mapping read does not block host watchdog; no worker restart
Bounded pipe frames/sequence and no leaked inherited handles to Sandbox
Complete empty baseline and validated persistent anchor before authorization
New foreign/replacement anchor after pin aborts; never kill by image name
Supervisor crash/restart ledger keeps UNKNOWN; accepted publication failure never triggers rerun
Source-only main always CLOSED/92 despite --unsafe --allow-runtime approved=true
Import all proposed modules with native DLL/subprocess/network calls forbidden
No old SCM01 test-factory/monkeypatch into live path
Guest bootstrap not invoked by tests/preflight; no scheduled task registration strings
Guard binary absent from capsule and output accepted inventory
No download/install/privilege/ACL/enrollment fallback anywhere
All fake outcomes explicitly OFFLINE_MODEL and not runtime issuer
Existing 22 core bytes and historical modules unchanged by package preparation
